events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has revealed the limits of US power and the rising geopolitical instability in the Middle East. The conflict has also shown the military strength of the US, but its waning geopolitical power. The situation is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.
events.reasoning: The ongoing conflict in Iran is expected to lead to increased volatility in the market, particularly in emerging markets and oil prices. A short position in EEM and a long position in DBO could potentially benefit from this situation.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for any signs of de-escalation

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if a ceasefire is announced or if oil prices drop below $60

events.title: NVIDIA AI Semiconductor Stocks
events.summary: NVIDIA's AI semiconductor stocks have been performing well, with the company investing in AI cable startups and partnering with TSMC to advance semiconductor design and manufacturing.
events.reasoning: NVIDIA's strong position in the AI semiconductor market and its recent partnerships and investments make it an attractive buy. Rotating into SMH could also provide exposure to the broader semiconductor market.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for any changes in NVIDIA's market position

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if NVIDIA's stock price drops below $200

gains.extendedNote: If NVIDIA's AI semiconductor business continues to grow

events.title: US Inflation Rate
events.summary: The US inflation rate has slowed down, with the latest data showing a decrease in inflation. This has led to expectations that the Fed will skip the July rate hike.
events.reasoning: The decrease in inflation has led to expectations of a more dovish Fed, which could lead to a decrease in interest rates. Buying TIP and shorting SPY could potentially benefit from this situation.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for any changes in the Fed's monetary policy

events.exitStrategy: Close positions if the Fed raises interest rates
